name: Return of Zero · Room 2 of 8 · §0 — Differentiating Mind
description: Mind is the movement by which an implicated whole becomes a determinate world for a situated subject. Six movements as addressable scenes in one shared section-room grammar. Binds to section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/ at Antykathera-Essay-Work dbf3b17.

text.title: Awareness Bends Toward Display
text.body:
The first differentiation is the reflexive bend by which luminous awareness takes its own manifestation as other enough to encounter.

text.title: The Inner Instrument
text.body:
Buddhi, ahaṃkāra, and manas are determinate internal functions—judgment, appropriation, and coordination—available to reflection as contents and operations. The subject remains the pole under which these functions and their products appear.
← previous · M07 Awareness Bends Toward Display   ·   next → M09 Vikalpa and Saṃkalpa
P1-M08 → A09 · A26 / C15 · C16 · C41 — regioned inner-instrument depth

text.title: Vikalpa and Saṃkalpa
text.body:
Mind constructs a context-world through a pulse: vikalpa differentiates and qualifies; saṃkalpa composes possibilities, intentions, and commitments from those differences.

text.title: Apoha
text.body:
Determination arises through exclusion: a selected 1 is intelligible against the field of what it is not.
← previous · M09 Vikalpa and Saṃkalpa   ·   next → M11 The Sixfold Tattvic Compression

text.title: The Sixfold Tattvic Compression
text.body:
The thirty-six tattvas can be carried argumentatively as six movements: Paramaśiva/Anuttara; Śiva–Śakti; Sadāśiva–Īśvara; Sadvidyā–Māyā; the kañcukas and complete contracted apparatus; Pratyabhijñā.

P1-M11 → A09 / C14 · C15 · C16 · C17 — Apportionment/Economy; sixfold compression is a reading, not source-tradition identity

text.title: Objective Internality
text.body:
Objective Internality is the constituted means through which a Life inhabits, discriminates and acts within a World.
